name: TASK-profile-icon-consistency — 관리 콘솔 제품 아이콘 Identicon + 명칭 순서 (authed)

steps.script: (async()=>{var row=document.querySelector('#productList .admin-list-row');if(row)row.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));var av=document.querySelector('#productDetail .admin-avatar');var hasImg=av?!!av.querySelector('.avatar-img, img'):false;var hasSvg=av?!!av.querySelector('svg'):false;var nameEl=document.querySelector('#productDetail .admin-account-name');var avText=av?av.textContent.trim():'';return JSON.stringify({avatarPresent:!!av,avatarKind:(hasImg?'img':(hasSvg?'identicon':(avText?'initials-text':'empty'))),avatarTextLen:avText.length,detailName:nameEl?nameEl.textContent:null,detailNameStartsWithParen:nameEl?nameEl.textContent.trim().startsWith('('):null});})()
